blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
With the continuous expansion of aquaculture, precise and efficient monitoring of fish behavior has become increasingly critical for improving farming efficiency and reducing economic losses. In particular, with the ongoing enhancement of computational capabilities in deep learning models, vision-based fish segmentation methods are garnering growing attention. By analyzing video segmentation results, fish behavior can be effectively tracked, thereby providing reliable data support for the precise regulation of aquaculture environments.
However, existing deep learning-based video segmentation methods for aquaculture scenarios often overlook the dynamic correlations between video frames. In contrast, Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS) employs an interaction-propagation scheme to achieve high-precision segmentation while minimizing user effort, thereby enhancing monitoring efficiency. Yet, IVOS applications in aquaculture remain limited due to data scarcity, and are susceptible to error accumulation and mask loss over long sequence propagation due to high intra-class similarity. In response, this paper proposes an improved interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and constructs two fish-specific datasets. FiVOS utilizes a mask block filter to enable early detection and correction of erroneous propagated mask blocks, enhancing filtering accuracy through a rule-based thresholding approach. Additionally, it serializes noise filters to further eliminate erroneous mask noise, thereby improving model robustness. Experimental results demonstrate that FiVOS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in fish video segmentation tasks, providing robust technical support for fish behavior research.
blocks.zh:
随着水产养殖业的持续扩展,对鱼类行为的准确有效的监测对提高养殖效率和减少经济损失越来越重要。 特别是,随着深度学习模型计算能力的不断增强,基于视觉的鱼分法正日益受到关注。 通过分析视频分解结果,可以有效跟踪鱼类行为,从而为准确调控水产养殖环境提供可靠的数据支持.
然而,现有的基于学习的水产养殖情景视频分解方法往往忽略了视频帧之间的动态关联。 相比之下,互动视频对象分集(IVOS)则采用交互传播方案,实现高精度分集,同时尽量减少用户的努力,从而提高监测效率. 然而,由于数据稀缺,水产养殖中的IVOS应用仍然有限,由于类内高度相似,容易出现错误积累,并掩盖长期序列传播的损失。 对此,本文提出了改进的交互式视频物体分解方法(FiVOS),并构建了两个针对鱼类的数据集. FiVOS使用遮罩块滤波器,可以及早发现并纠正错误的传播遮罩块,通过基于规则的阈值方法提高过滤精度. 此外,它还将噪声滤波器序列化,以进一步消除错误的口罩噪声,从而提高模型稳健性. 实验结果表明,FiVOS在鱼视频分解任务中实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能,为鱼的行为研究提供了有力的技术支持.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Information on fish characterization not only provides essential data support for the aquaculture sector, helping scientists and researchers better understand fish growth, health conditions, and behavioral patterns to optimize aquaculture management and resource allocation [ 31 , 16 ] , but also serves as foundational data for studying fish adaptability in ecological environments, contributing to a deeper understanding of fish physiology and behavioral characteristics [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 鱼类特征信息不仅为水产养殖部门提供了重要数据支持,帮助科学家和研究人员更好地了解鱼类生长,健康状况,行为模式,以优化水产养殖管理和资源分配[31,16],还成为研究生态环境中鱼类适应性的基础数据,有助于更深入地了解鱼类生理学和行为特征[29].

blocks.en:
However, conventional methods, such as manual observation, direct identification, and sensory evaluation, face notable limitations in data acquisition efficiency and accuracy, and may even adversely affect fish welfare and growth. Thus, there is an urgent need for advanced techniques to efficiently extract fish characterization information. The rise and development of computer vision and artificial intelligence technologies have introduced efficient and non-invasive solutions for extracting fish characterization information.
In recent years, researchers have conducted extensive exploration of image data through computer vision technologies, using techniques such as segmentation, object detection, and object tracking [ 13 , 25 , 18 ] . These techniques have initially facilitated the development of various fish-related models, such as fish identification [ 12 , 6 ] , behavior analysis [ 39 , 32 ] , and quantity estimation [ 36 ] , among others [ 40 , 11 , 28 ] .
Meanwhile, the integration of video data has further propelled research in fish characterization. Video data holds significant value not only in fish behavior analysis, health monitoring, and ecosystem observation but also in unveiling fish behavior patterns, social structures, and ecological adaptability across different environmental conditions [ 7 , 37 ] . Through the analysis of fish video data, researchers can gain a deeper understanding of fish stress responses, feeding habits, and reproductive behaviors, establishing a critical foundation for more precise tracking and analysis of fish activity patterns.
Although fish characterization research has made substantial progress in aquaculture and ecology, significant challenges remain in efficiently and accurately extracting dynamic behavior features of fish, particularly in complex aquatic environments. Consequently, this study presents an interactive fish video object segmentation method tailored for aquaculture scenarios, designed to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of fish characterization information extraction. This method offers a novel tool for identifying and analyzing fish behavior and health status, holding significant implications for intelligent aquaculture management.
blocks.zh:
然而,诸如人工观察、直接识别和感官评价等传统方法在数据获取效率和准确性方面面临显著的局限性,甚至可能对鱼类的福利和生长产生不利影响。 因此,迫切需要采用先进技术,有效提取鱼类特征信息。 计算机视觉和人工智能技术的兴起和发展为提取鱼类特征信息引入了高效且非侵入性解决方案.
近年来,研究人员通过计算机视觉技术对图像数据进行了广泛的探索,利用了分割,物体检测,物体跟踪等技术[13,25,18]. 这些技术最初促进了各种与鱼类有关的模型的发展,例如鱼类识别[12,6],行为分析[39,32],以及数量估计[36]等[40,11,28].
同时,视频数据的整合进一步推动了鱼类特征研究。 视频数据不仅在鱼类行为分析、健康监测和生态系统观测方面,而且在揭示不同环境条件的鱼类行为模式、社会结构和生态适应性方面,都具有重要价值[7、37]。 通过分析鱼类视频数据,研究人员可以更深入地了解鱼类应激反应,喂养习惯,以及繁殖行为,为更精确地跟踪和分析鱼类活动模式奠定了重要的基础.
虽然鱼类特征研究在水产养殖和生态学领域取得了重大进展,但在高效和准确地提取鱼类的动态行为特征方面仍然存在重大挑战,特别是在复杂的水生环境中。 因此,本研究提出了针对水产养殖情景的互动式鱼物视频分片方法,旨在提高鱼特性信息提取的准确性和效率。 这种方法为识别和分析鱼类行为和健康状况提供了新的工具,对明智的水产养殖管理具有重大影响。

blocks.en:
In recent years, fish behavior monitoring has gained significant attention in aquaculture and ecological conservation. Researchers have developed various segmentation, recognition, and tracking models to extract fish characterization information from video data, addressing the needs of automated monitoring and behavior analysis. These studies have laid a solid foundation for the development of algorithmic models [ 34 ] .
Rapid identification of abnormal behavior in fish is crucial for aquaculture management. Early fish behavior monitoring research was largely based on traditional computer vision techniques such as frame differencing, background subtraction, and optical flow [ 26 , 35 ] . However, these methods have difficulty capturing fish motion information along the depth axis, which affects the accuracy of behavior analysis. For instance, VM Papadakis et al. [ 22 ] employed background subtraction to detect changes in fish speed and position, analyzing escape and net-biting behaviors. Nonetheless, because it is limited to a two-dimensional plane, this method could not fully leverage the depth information of fish swimming, a crucial behavioral characteristic.
To enhance the comprehensive capture of fish swimming information, Pedersen et al. [ 23 ] developed an RGB 3D video dataset of zebrafish and applied background subtraction and head localization to detect fish head positions, enabling three-dimensional trajectory reconstruction. However, this method is prone to target loss during detection and tracking, which decreases detection accuracy.
To tackle this challenge, Weiran Li et al. [ 10 ] developed a multi-fish tracking model (TFMFT) based on the Transformer architecture [ 30 ] , which effectively overcomes tracking loss in complex backgrounds, thereby enhancing accuracy in individual trajectory monitoring and health evaluation. Although these methods have achieved satisfactory results, their ability to identify local abnormal behaviors remains limited. To address this issue, Jian Zhao et al. [ 38 ] employed a combination of an improved Motion Influence Map and a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to systematically detect, locate, and identify local abnormal behaviors of fish in intensive aquaculture environments, markedly improving the accuracy of local abnormal behavior detection in dense conditions. In summary, fish behavior monitoring technology has progressed from traditional methods to extensive applications of deep learning, offering effective tools for precise monitoring in complex aquatic and dense aquaculture environments, thus promoting the realization of automation and efficiency.
blocks.zh:
近年来,鱼类行为监测在水产养殖和生态保护中获得了显著关注. 研究人员开发了各种分化、识别和跟踪模型,从视频数据中提取鱼类特征信息,满足自动监测和行为分析的需要。 这些研究为算法模型的发展奠定了坚实的基础[34].
迅速查明鱼类的异常行为对水产养殖管理至关重要。 早期的鱼类行为监测研究主要基于传统的计算机视觉技术,如框架差异、背景减值和光学流[26,35]。 然而,这些方法很难沿着深度轴捕获鱼类运动信息,这影响了行为分析的准确性. 例如,VM Papadakis等人,《世界植物物种名录》,第19页。 [22]使用背景减法来检测鱼速和位置的变化,分析逃跑和网咬行为. 尽管如此,由于它仅限于二维平面,这种方法无法充分利用鱼类游泳的深度信息,而这种深度信息是关键的行为特征.
为加强鱼泳信息的全面捕捉,Pedersen等人著. [23]开发了斑马鱼的RGB 3D视频数据集,并应用了背景减值和头部局部化来检测鱼头位置,使得三维轨道重建成为可能. 然而,这种方法在检测和跟踪过程中容易发生目标丢失,这降低了检测精度.
为迎接这一挑战,Weiran Li et al. [10] 基于变形金刚架构[30]开发了多鱼追踪模型(TFMFT),有效克服了复杂背景的追踪损失,从而提高了单个轨迹监测和健康评价的准确性. 尽管这些方法取得了令人满意的结果,但它们识别当地异常行为的能力仍然有限. 为解决这一问题,詹昭等. [38] 结合经过改进的动因影响图和经常性神经网络(RNN),系统地检测,定位,识别集约水产养殖环境中的鱼类局部异常行为,显著提高密集条件下局部异常行为检测的准确性. 总之,鱼类行为监测技术已从传统方法发展到深入学习的广泛应用,为在复杂的水生和密集水产养殖环境中进行精确监测提供了有效的工具,从而促进自动化和效率的实现。

blocks.en:
Video Object Segmentation (VOS) is designed to perform high-quality foreground/background segmentation of target objects in video sequences, with wide applications in video analysis, comprehension, and editing.
Based on the degree of user intervention, VOS methods are divided into Automatic Video Object Segmentation (AVOS), Semi-automatic Video Object Segmentation (SVOS), and Interactive Video Object Segmentation (IVOS).
IVOS facilitates the segmentation process with simple user interactions (e.g., points, scribbles, or bounding boxes), achieving efficient segmentation of target objects at a low annotation cost, which offers distinct advantages in flexibly segmenting specific objects.
In earlier studies [ 1 ] , IVOS was implemented by combining two separate modules: an interactive image segmentation model [ 33 , 27 ] to generate a target mask for a single frame based on user annotations, and an SVOS model [ 2 , 21 ] to propagate this mask from the annotated frame to other frames. Later, SW Oh proposed a more compact solution [ 20 ] , where the model still used two separate modules for interaction and propagation, but incorporated internal connections through intermediate feature exchange and introduced external conditional links, enabling cooperation between the two modules. In IVOS-ATNet [ 9 ] , this design was continued, with further optimization of the propagation module to separately handle tracking and propagation of local (neighboring frames) and global (distant frames) masks. However, these methods [ 1 , 9 ] require re-running forward computations in each interaction round, leading to a gradual decline in efficiency as interaction rounds increase. To enhance efficiency, MA-Net [ 17 ] proposed a more efficient solution, centered on generating pixel embedding features through a unified encoder at the initial stage, and introducing two small branch networks for interactive segmentation and mask propagation. This model extracts pixel embeddings for all frames only in the initial round, while subsequent rounds perform forward computations solely within the two shallow branches, significantly boosting interaction efficiency. In summary, IVOS enables real-time interaction between user and task, offering high flexibility, rapid response, and low annotation costs, making it a practical solution for fish behavior detection.
blocks.zh:
视频对象分区(VOS)旨在对视频序列中的目标对象进行高质量的前景/背景分区,在视频分析,理解和编辑方面有广泛的应用.
根据用户干预的程度,VOS方法分为自动视频对象分区(AVOS),半自动视频对象分区(SVOS)和交互式视频对象分区(IVOS).
IVOS通过简单的用户交互(如点,拼图,或边框)促进分割过程,以较低的注释成本实现目标对象的高效分割,这在灵活分割特定对象方面提供了显著的优势.
在之前的研究[1]中,IVOS是合并两个独立的模块实施的:一个是交互式图像分割模型[33,27],为基于用户说明的单个帧生成目标遮罩,另一个是SVOS模型[2,21],将这个遮罩从附加说明的帧传播到其他帧. 后来 SW 系统 吴提出更紧凑的解决方案[20],即模型仍然使用两个独立的模块进行交互和传播,但通过中间特征交换整合了内部连接,并引入了外部有条件的链接,使得两个模块之间能够开展合作. 在IVOS-ATNet[9]中,这种设计得以继续,进一步优化了传播模块,以分别处理本地(邻框)和全球(远框)口罩的跟踪和传播。 然而,这些方法[1,9]需要在每个互动回合中重新进行前置计算,导致随着互动回合的增加,效率逐渐下降. 为了提高效率,MA-Net[17]提出了一个更有效率的解决办法,其重点是在初始阶段通过一个统一的编码器生成像素嵌入特性,并引入两个小分支网络进行交互分割和面具传播。 此模型只在初始回合中提取所有帧的像素嵌入,而后续的回合则仅在两个浅分支内进行前期计算,大大提高了交互效率. 简言之,IVOS可以使用户与任务之间实时互动,提供高度灵活性,快速反应,以及低注资,成为鱼类行为检测的实用解决方案.

blocks.en:
Current methods for fish behavior analysis do not deeply utilize dynamic correlations between video frames and lack specific object focus, making it prone to interference when capturing individual fish behavior characteristics. This limitation is particularly evident in multi-object environments, where target confusion and feature loss are common issues.
In comparison, interactive video object segmentation provides an advantage by focusing on specific objects, allowing for more targeted tracking.
Nevertheless, while current interactive video object segmentation algorithms excel on public datasets, they encounter challenges in fish farming environments, not only due to data scarcity but also from interference by complex factors such as water flow and lighting, which make high precision difficult to sustain. Even after multiple rounds of interactive correction, segmentation accuracy remains limited.
Furthermore, in fish farming, it is common to concentrate fish of the same species and growth stage within the same environment. This practice leads to high intra-class similarity between individuals, making it difficult to distinguish them during propagation and intensifying the error accumulation effect in interactive video segmentation.
As illustrated in Figure 1 .
Interactive video object segmentation also faces the problem of “catastrophic forgetting”, which refers to the potential loss of target masks during long-sequence propagation.
blocks.zh:
目前鱼类行为分析的方法并没有深入利用视频帧之间的动态关联,并且缺乏特定的对象焦点,因此在捕捉单个鱼类行为特征时容易发生干扰. 这种限制在多对象环境中尤其明显,因为目标混淆和特征损失是常见问题。
相比之下,交互式视频对象分解通过聚焦特定对象提供了优势,可以进行更有针对性的跟踪.
然而,虽然目前的交互式视频物体分解算法在公共数据集方面优异,但它们在养鱼环境中面临挑战,这不仅是因为数据稀缺,也因为水流和照明等复杂因素的干扰,使得高度精度难以维持。 即使经过多轮的交互式校正,分区精度仍然有限.
此外,在养鱼业中,常见的情况是在同一环境中将同一鱼种和生长阶段的鱼类集中。 这种做法导致个人之间等级内高度相似,在传播过程中难以区分,并强化了互动视频分区中的错误积累效应.
如图1所示。
互动视频物体分解还面临“灾难性遗忘”问题,即目标口罩在长期传播过程中可能丢失。

blocks.en:
To address the aforementioned issues, this paper introduces an innovative interactive video object segmentation method (FiVOS) and develops two fish-specific datasets for training FiVOS.
The first dataset contains static images of 1,350 fish instances, offering a wealth of fish appearance features.
The second pseudo-dynamic dataset comprises 23 image sequences, with each sequence containing 10 consecutive frames to capture fish motion characteristics.
Both datasets include pixel-level mask annotations, offering precise supervisory information for model training.
In the FiVOS method, to alleviate error accumulation due to high intra-class similarity, a specialized mask block filter is designed, enabling the model to detect and filter erroneous mask blocks early in the propagation process.
To further eliminate residual erroneous noise potentially left by the mask block filter, this method incorporates a noise filter equipped with median filtering to remove erroneous mask noise, thereby enhancing the model’s robustness.
Finally, a rule-based thresholding method is employed to set the optimal distance threshold, enhancing the accuracy of erroneous mask detection.
The contributions of this paper include the following:
blocks.zh:
为解决上述问题,本文引入了一种创新的交互式视频物体分割法(FiVOS),并开发了两套针对鱼类的数据集,用于培训FiVOS.
第一个数据集包含1 350个鱼类案例的静态图像,提供了丰富的鱼类外观特征.
第二个伪动力数据集包含23个图像序列,每个序列包含10个连续帧以捕捉鱼类运动特征.
两个数据集都包含像素级的面具说明,为模型培训提供了精确的监督信息.
在FiVOS方法中,为缓解由于类内高度相似而导致的错误积累,设计了一个专门的口罩块滤波器,使该模型能够在传播过程早期检测和过滤错误口罩块.
为了进一步消除面具块滤波器可能留下的残留错误噪声,这种方法包含了装有中位滤波器的噪声滤波器,以去除错误的面具噪声,从而提高模型的稳健性.
最后,采用了基于规则的阈值法来设定最佳距离阈值,提高了错误的面具检测的准确性.

blocks.en: 1. This paper proposes an interactive video object segmentation method for aquaculture, termed FiVOS. This method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on fish videos, offering a powerful tool for fish behavior feature analysis. 2. A novel filtering scheme is introduced for the detection and correction of erroneous mask blocks. This scheme comprises a serial arrangement of a mask block filter and a noise filter, which enhances the accuracy of generated masks by refining dynamically generated coarse masks during propagation. It substantially improves segmentation performance for tasks with high intra-class similarity and in challenging environments. 3. Two fish-specific datasets were developed for FiVOS training: a static image dataset containing 1,350 fish instances, and a pseudo-dynamic dataset comprising 23 image sequences extracted from videos, with each sequence containing 10 consecutive frames to capture local movement characteristics of fish.

blocks.en: 2 Materials and methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集的获取

blocks.en:
The experimental data was collected at the National Innovation Center for Digital Fishery.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , a smartphone equipped with 48MP main camera, 4K video recording at 60 FPS and optical image stabilization
was used to capture clear and stable video footage under different lighting and aquatic conditions. The tank used for the experiments is a circular acrylic tank with a diameter of 1.5 m and a depth of 0.4 m, specifically designed to provide a stable and controlled environment for the fish.
blocks.zh:
实验数据由国家数字渔业创新中心收集.
如图2所示,一台配备48MP主照相机的智能手机,60 FPS的4K录像和光学图像稳定
用于在不同照明和水生条件下拍摄清晰稳定的录像。 用于实验的罐体是直径为1.5米,深度为0.4米的圆锥体罐体,具体设计目的是为鱼提供稳定和可控的环境.

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 : Data Collection Schematic.
Videos of fish swimming in a tank are captured using a high-resolution camera, covering the entire water surface. The videos are then processed on a computer to generate the Fish-static and Fish-DAVIS datasets.

blocks.en: In this study, rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) was selected as the observation species due to its status as one of the earliest domesticated economic fish, which benefits from well-established aquaculture practices and serves as a benchmark for behavioral research, and its streamlined body facilitates the precise tracking of movement patterns (e.g., swimming trajectories and postural changes), thereby enabling the construction of a high-precision dataset under controlled conditions [ 8 ] . During data collection, we ensured that the fish were able to move freely within the tank, allowing the data to represent their natural behavior.
blocks.zh: 在这次研究中,虹鳟(英語:Oncorhynchus mykiss)因其作为最早的驯化经济鱼类之一的地位而被选为观测物种,它得益于既定的水产养殖做法,并成为行为研究的基准,其精简的机体有利于精确跟踪运动模式(如游泳轨迹和姿势变化),从而能够在控制条件下构建高精度数据集[8]. 在数据收集过程中,我们确保了鱼在鱼缸内能够自由移动,使得数据能够代表它们的自然行为.

blocks.en:
To further ensure the stability of the experimental environment and the reliability of the experimental data, we monitored and recorded the key water quality parameters in the experimental setup, including water level, water temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen concentration. These parameters play a crucial role in influencing fish behavior and health. Therefore, throughout the entire experimental process, we ensured that the water quality remained within an appropriate range.
As shown in Tab. 1 , the water quality parameters in the experimental environment exhibited minor fluctuations and were within the suitable range for the growth and behavioral studies of rainbow trout. The average water temperature was 21.85°C ± 1.04°C, which is close to the optimal growth range for rainbow trout (13°C to 18°C) and still within its tolerable range (0°C to 25°C). Additionally, the average dissolved oxygen concentration was 9.13 ± 1.21 mg/L, consistently exceeding the minimum dissolved oxygen requirement for rainbow trout growth (5 mg/L). The pH value averaged 7.44 ± 0.18, which is near neutral and conducive to the normal living conditions of rainbow trout.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步保证实验环境的稳定性和实验数据的可靠性,我们监测和记录了实验设置中的关键水质参数,包括水位,水温,pH,溶解氧浓度. 这些参数在影响鱼类行为和健康方面发挥关键作用。 因此,在整个试验过程中,我们确保水质保持在适当范围内。
如图1所示,实验环境中的水质参数略有波动,在虹鳟生长和行为研究的适当范围内。 平均水温21.85° C±1.04°C,它接近虹鳟鱼的最佳生长范围(13°C至18°C),并且仍在其可容忍范围内(0°C至25°C). 此外,平均溶解氧浓度为9.13±1.21毫克/升,持续超过虹鳟生长所需的最低溶解氧要求(5毫克/升)。 pH值平均为7.44±0.18,接近中性,有利于虹鳟的正常生活条件.

blocks.en:
During filming, the camera was positioned above and to the side of the tank, ensuring coverage of the entire pool area to maximize capture of fish activities within the tank.
Upon completion of filming, the video data was transferred to a computer via a data cable for further processing.
In the data processing phase, a Python script was used to extract video frames, capturing one frame every five frames and saving them in JPG format, thereby forming a static image sequence for subsequent annotation and model training.
Then, each frame’s fish contours were manually annotated at the pixel level using the AnyLabeling tool, ensuring high-quality data support for the IVOS task.
blocks.zh:
在拍摄期间,摄影机位于油箱上方和侧面,确保覆盖整个池区,以最大限度地捕获油箱内的鱼类活动.
拍摄完成后,视频数据通过数据电缆转移到一台计算机进行进一步处理.
在数据处理阶段,一个Python脚本被用来提取视频帧,每五个帧捕获一个帧,并以JPG格式保存,从而形成一个静态图像序列,用于后续的注释和模型训练.
之后,每个帧的鱼轮廓都使用AnyLabeling工具在像素层面手动注释,确保IVOS任务获得高质量的数据支持.

The Fish-static dataset is a static image dataset. Each original image may contain multiple fish targets; in the dataset, the same original image is presented as multiple instances, each instance containing only one target mask.
We annotated a total of 225 images, encompassing 1,350 instances.
blocks.zh:
Fish-static数据集是一个静态图像数据集. 每个原始图像可能包含多个鱼靶;在数据集中,相同的原始图像作为多个实例呈现,每个实例只包含一个目标面具.
我们总共标注了225幅图像,包括1 350个实例。

blocks.en:
The Fish-DAVIS dataset is a standardized fish dataset specifically designed for interactive video object segmentation tasks [ 24 ] .
The dataset is composed of multiple video streams, sampled every 5 frames, with a complete data sequence constructed every 10 frames to ensure inter-frame continuity and simplify data processing.
Each set of image data is associated with a set of ground truth instance masks and three randomly selected single-frame scribble annotation files, supplying adequate scribble annotations and supervisory information for the model’s propagation and fusion modules.
Furthermore, the dataset includes a JSON file for validation purposes, offering detailed attribute information of video sequences (such as frame count, number of interaction files, object count, frame dimensions, etc.) to support evaluation requirements.
blocks.zh:
Fish-DAVIS数据集是专门为交互式视频物体分割任务设计的标准化鱼类数据集[24].
数据集由多个视频流组成,每5帧进行取样,每10帧构建一个完整的数据序列,以确保帧间连续性和简化数据处理.
每组图像数据都与一套地面真象口罩和三套随机选择的单帧注解文件有关,为模型的传播和聚变模块提供了充分的注解和监督信息。
此外,数据集还包括一个JSON文件,用于验证目的,提供视频序列的详细属性信息(如帧计数,互动文件数量,对象计数,帧维度等),以支持评价要求.

blocks.en: 2.2 Proposed method
blocks.zh: 2.2 拟议方法

blocks.en: 2.2.1 FiVOS Overview
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 保险系统 概览

blocks.en: This study builds upon MiVOS [ 4 ] and employs a ”three-stage” modular structure for derivation and training. The three modules are the Interaction Module, the Propagation Module, and the Fusion Module.
blocks.zh: 这项研究以MiVOS[4]为基础,采用“三阶段”模块结构进行推导和培训。 这三个模块是互动模块、传播模块和融合模块。

blocks.en:
In the Interaction Module, the system operates within an instant feedback loop, allowing users to receive real-time feedback. This ensures satisfactory results on individual frames before moving on to the more time-consuming propagation process. In the initial round, all masks are initialized to zero. The user selects a frame t t and interactively refines the object mask using the Scribble-to-Mask (S2M) module until the results are satisfactory.
Next, during the mask Propagation process, the refined mask from the selected frame is bidirectionally propagated across the entire video sequence, producing an initial set of rough prediction masks. To address the issues of high intra-class similarity within datasets and exponential error accumulation, these initial prediction masks are evaluated before adjacent frame propagation. Specifically, the system assesses the number of mask blocks in the current target’s prediction mask. If the predicted mask contains more than one block, the system engages a mask filter to determine whether the prediction mask includes misidentified regions. The filter removes erroneous mask blocks and generates a more accurate prediction mask. Conversely, if the predicted mask has only one block, it is assumed to be error-free and bypasses the filtering process.
Finally, the Fusion Module integrates the propagated masks with the results from the previous iteration. It captures user intent by analyzing the differences between masks selected before and after user interaction. These differences guide the fusion process to further refine the mask. Since this module is not the primary focus of our study, we will not elaborate on its details here.
The schematic of FiVOS is illustrated in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh:
在互动模块中,系统在即时反馈循环中运行,允许用户接受实时反馈. 这确保了在进入更耗时的传播过程之前,单个框架取得令人满意的结果。 在首轮中,所有口罩都初始化为0. 用户选择一个帧 t t,并使用Scrible-to-Mask(S2M)模块对对象掩码进行交互精炼,直至结果令人满意.
接下来,在口罩传播过程中,从所选框中提炼出来的口罩被双向传播到整个视频序列,产生了一套初步的粗略预测口罩. 为了解决数据集内部高度相似和指数误差积累的问题,在相邻的框架传播之前对这些初步预测口罩进行评估。 具体来说,系统评估了当前目标预测罩中的口罩块数. 如果预测口罩包含多个块,系统会使用一个口罩过滤器,以确定预测口罩是否包含被误认的区域. 过滤器去除错误的遮罩块,并生成更准确的预测遮罩. 反之,如果预测的面具只有一个块,则假设它没有错误,绕过过滤过程.
最后,Fusion模块将所传播的口罩与前次迭代的结果融合在一起. 它通过分析用户互动前后所选择的口罩的差异来捕捉用户的意向. 这些差异指导了核聚变过程进一步细化面具. 由于本单元不是我们研究的主要重点,我们不在此详述其细节。

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Propagation Module
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 宣传单元

blocks.en:
The Propagation Module is a hybrid mask prediction process, integrating both soft processing (via a space-time memory reader) and hard processing (through a mask block filter and noise filter) [ 4 ] .
The structure of the propagation model is illustrated in Fig. 4 .
Given one or more object masks, the propagation module tracks the objects and generates corresponding initial prediction masks for subsequent frames.
Using STM with a Top-k operation [ 14 , 21 , 15 ] , past frames containing object masks are treated as memory frames, which are employed to predict the object mask in the current (query) frame via an attention-based memory reading operation.
It is worth noting that to address STM error accumulation caused by high intra-class similarity within the fish dataset, we propose a novel mask filter. This simple yet effective method filters out unreasonable mask blocks within the query mask via a mask block filter, ensuring the quality of memory masks in the subsequent propagation stage and alleviating target confusion and exponential error accumulation resulting from high intra-class similarity.
Even with minor recognition errors during propagation, the mask filter suppresses distant erroneous mask blocks, enabling the network to correct these errors in subsequent propagation steps and preventing the further spread of erroneous information.
Following the mask block filter, there may still be error specks in the mask, as individual error specks may not qualify as complete mask blocks. Thus, we introduced a noise filter to eliminate these potential error specks, thereby further enhancing the quality of the query mask.
Because this mask filter performs hard-processing on mask blocks, it can be flexibly integrated into various SVOS models.
blocks.zh:
传播模块是一个混合掩码预测过程,将软处理(通过时空内存读器)和硬处理(通过掩码块滤波器和噪声滤波器)[4]两者结合起来.
图4说明了传播模型的结构。
鉴于一个或多个物体口罩,传播模块跟踪物体,并为后续帧生成相应的初始预测口罩.
使用带有Top-k操作 [14, 21, 15]的STM,过去装有物体口罩的帧作为内存帧处理,这些帧用于通过基于注意力的内存读取操作来预测当前(query)帧中的对象口罩.
值得注意的是,为了解决鱼类数据集内部高度相似导致的STM误差积累问题,我们提议采用新的遮盖滤波器. 这种简单但有效的方法通过遮罩块过滤器过滤出查询掩码内不合理的掩码块,确保了后期传播阶段的内存掩码的质量,并缓解了由于类内高度相似而导致的目标混淆和指数误差积累.
即便在传播过程中有小的识别错误,遮罩过滤器也会压制远处的错误遮罩块,使网络能够在后续的传播步骤中纠正这些错误,并防止错误信息的进一步传播.
口罩块过滤器之后,口罩中可能仍然存在错误的光谱,因为单个错误光谱可能不符合完整的口罩块的条件. 因此,我们引入了一个噪声过滤器来消除这些潜在的错误谱,从而进一步提高了查询掩码的质量.
由于这个面具过滤器在面具块上进行硬处理,可以灵活地整合到各种SVOS模型中.

(b) The Mask Block Filter identifies and removes misidentified regions from the initial prediction mask. (c) The Noise Filter eliminates residual noise to further refine the mask.

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Space-time memory reader
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 时空记忆阅读器

blocks.en:
The space-time memory reader [ 21 ] module receives the initial mask input of the target object, tracks the specified object, and generates corresponding prediction masks in subsequent frames.
As illustrated in Fig. 4 (a), this module has two input branches: one for memory frames (past frames) with object masks and one for query frames (current frames) without object masks.
Memory and query frames are passed through dedicated encoders to generate key and value mappings. The memory encoder receives both the image and the object mask, while the query encoder receives only the image.
For T T memory frames, key-value features are computed and then multiplied via dot product to generate a similarity matrix F F , indicating the similarity between query positions and memory positions.
To enhance efficiency and minimize memory usage, a Top- k k filter retains only the top k k entries with the highest similarity values.
The filtered similarity matrix W W is multiplied by v M v^{M} to produce feature m m , which is then concatenated with v Q v^{Q} and sent to the decoder to generate the initial object mask.
The Scatter operation distributes data to specified index positions, forming a new similarity feature matrix W W , thereby further improving computational efficiency and feature alignment.
blocks.zh:
时空内存阅读器[21]模块接收目标物体的初始口罩输入,跟踪指定的物体,并在后续帧中生成相应的预测口罩.
如图4(a)所示,本模块有两个输入分支:一个用于内存框(past fram)与对象口罩,另一个用于查询框(current fram),没有对象口罩.
内存和查询框架通过专用编码器传递,生成密钥和值映射. 内存编码器同时接收图像和对象面具,而查询编码器只接收图像.
对于T T 内存框架,键值特性通过点产品计算并乘以生成相似性矩阵F F ,表示查询位置与内存位置的相似性.
为了提高效率和尽量减少内存使用,Top-k k过滤器只保留最相似值最高的Top-k k条目.
过滤过的相似性矩阵 W W 乘以 v M v^{M} 生成特征 m m , 然后与 v Q v^{Q} 缩合, 并发送到解码器生成初始对象掩码.
散射操作将数据分配到指定的索引位置,形成一个新的相似性特征矩阵W W,从而进一步提高计算效率和特征对齐.

blocks.en: 2.2.4 Mask block filter
blocks.zh: 2.2.4 国家 遮罩块过滤器

blocks.en:
Given the continuity of information in video streams, it is improbable for the centroid distances of mask blocks in adjacent frames to show sudden increases.
Based on this characteristic, we manually set a task-specific threshold using prior knowledge (For specific details, see Section 2.2.5). This threshold can be estimated as a reference value from the existing mask information in the dataset.
This approach helps alleviate target confusion and error diffusion issues caused by high intra-class similarity.
Even with minor recognition errors during propagation, the mask filter suppresses distant erroneous mask blocks, allowing the network to correct errors in subsequent propagation stages and preventing the further spread of errors.
As illustrated in Fig. 4 (b), the mask block filter operates by performing a many-to-many shortest distance matching between the initial object mask generated by STM and the mask blocks in adjacent frames. A minimum distance threshold is set to filter out incorrect mask blocks, ensuring the quality of memory masks in the subsequent propagation phase.
To enhance object tracking accuracy between video frames, this study calculates the maximum centroid distance within each frame as the primary reference indicator for centroid movement.
Based on this maximum distance, an empirical threshold is set to filter out frames with abnormal movement or incorrect detections.
This centroid-based maximum distance thresholding method can be regarded as a heuristic rule to promote tracking stability and accuracy in practical video processing.
As depicted in Fig. 5 , green dots indicate the centroids of predicted mask blocks in the current frame, while red dots indicate the centroids of mask blocks in adjacent memory frames.
In this example, the STM module generates two mask blocks for the current query frame, posing a risk of target recognition error.
The mask filter calculates the L2 norm (Euclidean distance) between the centroids of the predicted mask blocks and the centroids of mask blocks in adjacent memory frames, as follows:
blocks.zh:
鉴于视频流中信息的连续性,相邻帧中面具块的中间距离不可能显示突增.
基于这一特点,我们利用先前的知识(具体细节见第2.2.5节),手动确定了具体任务门槛。 这个阈值可以从数据集中现有的遮罩信息中作为参考值来估算.
这种方法有助于缓解由于阶级内部高度相似而造成的目标混淆和错误传播问题.
即使传播过程中有小的识别错误,遮罩过滤器也会压制远处的错误遮罩块,使网络能够纠正后续传播阶段的错误,防止错误的进一步扩散.
如图4(b)所示,口罩块过滤器的运作方式是在由STM生成的初始对象口罩和相邻边框中的口罩块之间进行许多到许多最短的距离匹配. 设定了最小距离阈值来过滤不正确的口罩块,确保内存口罩在接下来的传播阶段的质量.
为了提高视频帧之间的物体跟踪精度,本研究计算每个帧内的最大中间行星距离,作为中间行星运动的主要参考指标.
基于这个最大距离,设定了一个经验阈值来过滤带有异常运动或错误检测的帧.
这种基于百分行星的最大距离阈值法可以被视为一种热力学规则,以促进在实际视频处理中的跟踪稳定性和准确性.

blocks.en: 2.2.5 Rule-Based Thresholding Method
blocks.zh: 2.2.5 规则限制方法

blocks.en:
To enhance the accuracy of object tracking across video frames, this study proposes a threshold-setting method based on the centroid distance of object masks between adjacent frames.
This method can be seen as a heuristic rule. Specifically, we define D ​ T DT as the maximum movement distance of object mask centroids between adjacent frames to assess centroid displacement, using it as a filter for erroneous detection to maintain tracking stability and accuracy.

为了提高跨视频帧的物体跟踪的准确性,本研究根据相邻帧之间物体遮罩的中间距离,提出了设定阈值的方法.
这种方法可以看作是一个heuristic规则. 具体地说,我们把D T DT定义为相邻帧间物体遮罩百分位机器人的最大运动距离,以评估百分位机器人的位置,用它作为错误检测的过滤器,以保持跟踪稳定性和准确性.

blocks.en: 2.2.6 Noise filter
blocks.zh: 2.2.6 噪声过滤器

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 4 (c), after the mask block filter has processed the mask, small error specks of noise may still persist. These noise specks are generally too small to be identified as independent mask blocks, yet they can negatively impact the accuracy of subsequent processing stages.
To resolve this issue, we developed a noise filter specifically designed to eliminate these potential noise specks, further improving the quality of the query mask.
This noise filter employs a commonly used median filtering technique, which effectively removes isolated noise points in the image by replacing the target pixel’s value with the median of the surrounding pixels.
blocks.zh:
如图4(c)所示,面具块过滤器处理面具后,噪音的小错误片段可能仍然存在。 这些噪声光谱一般太小,无法被识别为独立的遮罩块,然而它们可能会对后续处理阶段的准确性产生不利影响.
为了解决这个问题,我们开发了一个噪声过滤器,专门用来消除这些潜在的噪声谱,进一步提高了查询罩的质量.
这种噪声滤波器采用了常用的中位滤波技术,通过将目标像素的值替换为周围像素的中位数,有效地去除图像中孤立的噪声点.

blocks.en: In the process of median filtering, the local window size W ⁡ ( x , y ) W(x,y) is the only adjustable and critical parameter. The window size directly determines the strength and precision of the filtering: smaller windows can preserve more detailed information but may be insufficient to eliminate larger noise artifacts, while larger windows can more effectively suppress noise but may introduce over-smoothing effects, leading to the loss of image details. To investigate the impact of the local window size on noise filtering performance and model accuracy, we conducted experiments using different window sizes and quantitatively analyzed the model performance. The experimental results are summarized in Tab. 3 .
blocks.zh: 在中位过滤过程中,本地窗口大小为QQ(x,y)W(x,y)是唯一可调整和关键参数. 窗口大小直接决定了过滤的强度和精度:较小的窗口可以保存更详细的信息,但可能不足以消除更大的噪声文物,而较大的窗口可以更有效地抑制噪声,但可能引入过沉效应,导致图像细节丢失. 为了调查本地窗口大小对噪声过滤性能和模型精度的影响,我们用不同的窗口大小进行了实验,并对模型性能进行了定量分析. 实验结果摘要载于Tab。 页:1

blocks.en:
When the window size is 3 × 3 3\times 3 , the model achieves optimal performance. This indicates that, at this window size, noise particles are effectively suppressed while preserving important details.
A smaller window size (e.g., 1 × 1 1\times 1 ) fails to adequately remove noise particles, thereby affecting the accuracy of subsequent processing stages. Conversely, an excessively large window size (e.g., 21 × 21 21\times 21 ) results in over-smoothing, leading to a loss of critical details and a reduction in model performance.
Therefore, we selected a window size of 3 × 3 3\times 3 as the default parameter for the median filter. This choice strikes an effective balance between noise suppression and detail preservation.
blocks.zh:
当窗口大小为3×3 3\times 3时,模型实现最佳性能. 这表明,在这个窗口大小上,噪声粒子在保存重要细节的同时被有效压制.
较小的窗口尺寸(如1×1×1\times 1)未能充分消除噪声颗粒,从而影响后续处理阶段的准确性. 反之,过于庞大的窗口尺寸(如21×21 21\time 21)导致过度舒缓,导致重要细节丢失,模型性能下降.
因此,我们选择了一个3×3 3\times 3的窗口大小作为中位过滤器的默认参数. 这一选择在噪音抑制和细节保存之间达成了有效的平衡。

blocks.en:
The median filter’s advantage is its ability to suppress small-area noise while retaining edge details in the image, making it particularly effective for addressing salt-and-pepper noise.
This design enables our noise filter to enhance the clarity and reliability of the mask, ensuring that small noise specks do not impact the system’s overall performance and accuracy in subsequent processing stages.
This combined approach of using both the mask block filter and the noise filter guarantees stability and accuracy when handling complex video stream data.
blocks.zh:
中位滤波器的优势在于它能够抑制小区域噪声,同时在图像中保留边缘细节,使得它特别能有效处理盐和pper噪.
这种设计使我们的噪声过滤器能够提高面具的清晰度和可靠性,确保小噪声谱片不会在以后的处理阶段影响系统的整体性能和准确性.
这种既使用遮罩块滤波器,又使用噪声滤波器的综合方法,保证了处理复杂视频流数据时的稳定性和准确性.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价尺度

blocks.en:
In interactive video object segmentation tasks, evaluating model performance is essential, as segmentation accuracy and interaction efficiency directly impact user experience.
This study uses the J & F J\&F and A ​ U ​ C − J & F AUC-J\&F metrics to evaluate segmentation accuracy, edge consistency, and overall performance across different interaction counts.
These evaluation metrics are widely accepted and interpretable in the field of video segmentation.
blocks.zh:
在交互式视频对象分区任务中,评价模型性能至关重要,因为分区精度和交互效率直接影响用户体验.
本研究使用J&F JQQF和A U C-J & F AUC-JQF的度量衡来评价分化精度,边缘一致性,以及不同相互作用计数的整体性能.
这些评价指标在视频分割领域得到广泛接受和解释。

blocks.en:
Specifically, the J & F J\&F metric combines the Jaccard Index ( J J ) and edge accuracy ( F F ) to provide an overall assessment of the segmentation region’s accuracy and edge consistency. J J assesses the accuracy of the segmented region by computing the Intersection over Union (IoU) between the segmentation result and the ground truth mask, while F F quantifies edge consistency by evaluating the alignment between the predicted and actual edges.
A high J & F J\&F value represents the model’s combined performance in segmentation accuracy and edge quality.

一个高的J&F JQQQ F值代表模型在分解精度和边缘质量方面的综合性能.
其计算公式如下:

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparison with other advanced tracking algorithms
blocks.zh: 3.3 与其他高级跟踪算法进行比较

blocks.en:
To evaluate our model’s performance, the bot (i.e., the official automatic scribble API) initially provides a scribble on a selected frame and waits for the algorithm’s output.
The bot then applies corrective scribbling to the worst-performing frame among all candidate frames generated by the algorithm.
This loop can be repeated a maximum of 8 times.
Notably, since we use the private interactive dataset Fish-DAVIS, this behavior is implemented by modifying the official API’s davis.json file.
In the quantitative analysis, we applied this automated process to produce experimental results using predefined metrics. In the qualitative analysis, we conducted real-time human interaction on a 20-second long video (1200 frames) within the PyQt interface to assess user experience and visual accuracy in practical application.
blocks.zh:
为了评价我们的模型的性能,bot(即官方的自动拼写API)最初在选定的帧上提供一个拼写,等待算法的输出.
机器人然后在算法生成的所有候选帧中,对表现最差的帧进行修正划线。
此循环最多可重复8次.
由于我们使用私人互动数据集Fish-DAVIS,
在定量分析中,我们运用这个自动化过程,用预先定义的度量衡来产生实验结果. 在定性分析中,我们在PyQt接口内进行了20秒长视频(1200帧)的实时人类互动,以评估用户体验和实际应用中的视觉精度.

blocks.en:
The performance of our method on the Fish-DAVIS interactive validation set is presented in Tab. 6 , alongside a comparison with results from current state-of-the-art methods.
All models were trained and validated on the same GPU (NVIDIA RTX 4070) to ensure fairness and consistency in the results.
The experimental results show that our method surpasses all competitors across various metrics.
However, due to the short sequence length of only 10 frames in the Fish-DAVIS interactive validation set, neither the MiVOS nor the STCN exhibited any erroneous mask blocks during this brief sequence test. As a result, no significant improvement was observed when compared to the FiVOS.
To provide a more comprehensive evaluation of model performance, we merged the Fish-DAVIS dataset into a long sequence of 80 frames for testing.
As shown in Tab. 7 , in this long-sequence test, our method significantly outperformed other comparison methods, exhibiting enhanced robustness and superior segmentation accuracy.

然而,由于Fish-DAVIS交互式验证集中只有10帧的短序列长度,因此在本次短序列测试中,MiVOS和STCN都没有显示任何错误的面具块. 因此,与FiVOS相比没有明显改善。
为了对模型性能进行更全面的评价,我们把Fish-DAVIS数据集合并为80帧的长序测试.

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 3.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of each component in the proposed FiVOS, we performed ablation studies on the Fish-DAVIS dataset using both short (10-frame) and long (80-frame) video sequences.
blocks.zh: 为了验证拟议FiVOS中每个部分的有效性,我们利用短(10帧)和长(80帧)视频序列对Fish-DAVIS数据集进行了消毒研究。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Mask block filter
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 国家 遮罩块过滤器

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 8 , adding the mask block filter resulted in a slight decrease in validation accuracy on the Fish-DAVIS short video (10 frames) compared to the baseline, with a difference of 0.371%, though there are specific reasons for this outcome.
Since recognition errors generally occur in longer videos (over 70 frames) during validation, this private dataset with only 10 frames did not reach the critical threshold for error accumulation.
In this scenario, error accumulation during validation was not severe enough to generate erroneous mask blocks, preventing the mask block filter from effectively performing its error-correction function.
However, in the Fish-DAVIS long video (80 frames), validation accuracy improved significantly after adding the mask block filter.
As shown in Tab. 9 , in long video validation, the method with the mask block filter improved validation accuracy by 4.6% over the baseline model.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所示. 8,加上口罩块滤波器,导致Fish-DAVIS短视频(10帧)的验证精度与基线相比略有下降,差距为0.371%,不过有具体原因导致这一结果.
由于识别错误一般发生在验证过程中较长的视频(超过70帧)中,这个只有10帧的私人数据集没有达到错误积累的关键阈值.
在这种假想中,验证过程中的错误积累不够严重,无法生成错误的遮罩块,使得遮罩块过滤器无法有效发挥其错误校正功能.
然而,在Fish-DAVIS长视频(80帧)中,在添加了面具块过滤器后,验证精度大大提高.
如Tab.9所示,在长视频验证中,带有遮罩块过滤器的方法比基准模型提高了4.6%的验证精度.

As illustrated in Figure 8 , section S(a) shows the results of single-object interactive video segmentation in the first propagation round.
It can be observed that the model without the filter exhibited target recognition errors after frame 75 from the interactive frame. As the frame count increased, errors rapidly accumulated, causing the extent of recognition errors to grow.
However, with the addition of the mask block filter, the model results in S(b) retained high recognition accuracy past frame 75, completely preventing recognition errors.
This suggests that in long video sequences, when recognition errors accumulate to trigger error diffusion, the mask block filter indeed plays a crucial role, effectively containing further error spread and enhancing model stability.
blocks.zh:
如图8所示,S(a)节显示在第一轮传播中单物体交互式视频分割的结果。
可以观察到的是,没有滤波器的模型从交互帧75后显示目标识别错误. 随着帧数的增加,误差迅速累积,导致识别误差程度增大.
然而,随着面具块过滤器的添加,S(b)中的模型结果保留了过去帧75的高识别精度,完全防止了识别错误.
这表明,在长视频序列中,当识别错误累积以触发错误扩散时,面具块滤波器确实发挥着关键作用,有效遏制了进一步的错误扩散,增强了模型稳定性.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Noise filter
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 联合国 噪声过滤器

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 8 , in the Fish-DAVIS short video validation, adding the noise filter increased accuracy by 0.604% over the baseline.
In the Fish-DAVIS long video validation shown in Tab. 9 , the accuracy improvement was even more substantial, with an increase of 17.6% over the baseline after adding the noise filter.
During noise filtering, the noise filter is essential for removing erroneous masks and reducing noise.
As shown in Figure 9 , M(a) and M(a)-L display instances of erroneous mask noise particles that may appear after the mask block filter removes incorrect mask blocks, with these particles also displaying an accumulation effect during propagation.
At this stage, the noise filter takes effect, as shown in M(b) and M(b)-L, where the median filter effectively removes these small erroneous particles. After noise filtering, the model’s recognition performance improves significantly, preventing further error propagation.

如图9所示,M(a)和M(a)-L显示在面具块过滤器清除不正确的面具块后可能出现的假面具噪声颗粒的情况,这些颗粒在传播过程中也表现出累积效应.

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Rule-Based Thresholding Method
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 基于规则的断层方法

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 8 , in the Fish-DAVIS short video dataset, defining the mask filter’s distance threshold through the rule-based thresholding method improved accuracy by 0.04% compared to manually set thresholds based on prior knowledge.
In the Fish-DAVIS long video validation shown in Tab. 9 , defining the mask filter’s distance threshold through the rule-based thresholding method improved accuracy by 9.4% compared to the manually set threshold.
By setting the optimal distance threshold using the rule-based thresholding method, accuracy reached its highest level.
blocks.zh:
如Tab.8所示,在Fish-DAVIS短视频数据集中,通过基于规则的阈值法确定遮罩过滤器的距离阈值,与根据先前的知识手工设定的阈值相比,精度提高了0.04%。
在Tab显示的Fish-DAVIS长视频验证中. 9,通过基于规则的阈值方法定义遮罩过滤器的距离阈值,与人工设定的阈值相比,精度提高了9.4%.
通过使用基于规则的阈值方法设定最佳距离阈值,精度达到了最高水平.

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 10 , in the long sequence video interaction results, while the manually set prior distance threshold successfully filtered out erroneous masks at frame 79, recognition errors reappeared after frame 146.
In contrast, the distance threshold derived using the rule-based thresholding method successfully filtered out erroneous masks at both frame 79 and frame 146.
This result demonstrates that, compared to manually set prior thresholds, the rule-based thresholding method offers a more precise distance threshold for identifying erroneous mask blocks, significantly improving the model’s stability and reliability in long-sequence video validation and achieving optimal segmentation performance.
blocks.zh:
如图10所示,在长序视频互动结果中,虽然手动设定的先前距离阈值在帧79成功过滤出错误的口罩,但识别错误在帧146后再次出现.
相比之下,使用基于规则的阈值方法得出的距离阈值在79帧和146帧均成功过滤出错误的口罩.
这一结果表明,与人工设定的先前阈值相比,基于规则的阈值方法为识别错误的遮罩块提供了更精确的距离阈值,大大提高了模型在长序视频验证中的稳定性和可靠性,实现了最佳的分区性能.

blocks.en: 3.4.4 Generalization Verification
blocks.zh: 3.4.4 普遍性核查

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 10 , the ablation experiment results on the public dataset DAVIS [ 24 ] indicate a slight decrease in accuracy by 0.529% and 0.792% after incorporating our filtering scheme.
This slight decrease is mainly due to the high contrast between targets and background in the public dataset and the low similarity between targets, which limits the filter’s effect on this dataset.
Additionally, in certain cases, the noise filter may inadvertently remove a small amount of information, causing a slight effect on the mask results.
However, this impact is minimal, statistically insignificant, and does not affect the overall performance of the method.
Notably, the mask block filter and noise filter were originally designed to address high intra-class similarity targets in complex aquatic environments, where this filtering mechanism shows its advantages.
In practical applications, a slight change in accuracy represents a reasonable trade-off for enhanced robustness.
blocks.zh:
如图10所示,公共数据集DAVIS[24]的衰减实验结果表明,在纳入我们的过滤方案后,精度略微下降0.529 %和0.792%。
这一略微的减少主要是由于公共数据集中的目标和背景之间的高度对比,以及目标之间的低相似度,限制了过滤器对这个数据集的影响.
此外,在某些情况下,噪声过滤器可能无意中移除少量信息,对口罩结果造成轻微影响.
然而,这种影响很小,在统计学上微不足道,不影响该方法的整体性能.
值得注意的是,面具区块过滤器和噪声过滤器最初旨在处理复杂水生环境中等级内高度相似的目标,这种过滤机制显示了其优点。
在实际应用中,精确度的微小变化代表了增强稳健性的合理权衡.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Robustness of the Method
blocks.zh: 4.1 方法的健全性

blocks.en:
To verify the robustness of the proposed FiVOS method, we conducted additional experiments in more complex scenarios.
First, we collected a video dataset of fish activity in a real aquaculture setting, which includes 150 farmed fish.
We then applied the dataset to both the baseline model (MiVOS) and the proposed FiVOS model, with the experimental results shown in Fig. 11 .
The left section with the green background presents the segmentation results of MiVOS, while the right section with the purple background shows the segmentation results of FiVOS.
We randomly selected two fish as interaction objects, with the results shown in Fig. 11 (a) and (b), respectively.
The first row shows screenshots of the algorithm’s segmentation results, and the second row shows the corresponding zoomed-in detail images.
From the detail images, it can be seen that the MiVOS model exhibits significant target confusion and target loss during segmentation; in contrast, the FiVOS model shows stable segmentation results without target confusion.
blocks.zh:
为了验证提议的FiVOS方法的稳健性,我们在更复杂的情景中进行了更多的实验.
首先,我们收集了一个视频数据集,显示在真正的水产养殖环境中的鱼类活动,其中包括150条养殖鱼。
然后,我们把数据集应用于基线模型(MIVOS)和拟议的FiVOS模型,实验结果如图11所示。
带有绿色背景的左段呈现出MiVOS的分割结果,而带有紫色背景的右段呈现出FiVOS的分割结果.
我们随机选择了两种鱼类作为相互作用的对象,结果分别见图11(a)和(b)。
第一行显示算法分解结果的截图,第二行显示相应的缩放细节图像.
从细节图像中可以看出,MiVOS模型在分割过程中显示出显著的目标混淆和目标丢失;相比之下,FiVOS模型则显示出稳定的分割结果,没有目标混淆.

blocks.en: To further validate the robustness of our method in underwater scenarios, we collected real underwater fish video data and conducted additional validation experiments. Specifically, we performed interactive segmentation on diseased fish in the videos. The experimental results in Fig. 12 show that our method maintains excellent segmentation performance despite partial occlusion of foreground targets by the background at frames 0, 25, and 51.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步验证我们在水下情景中方法的稳健性,我们收集了真正的水下鱼视频数据,并进行了额外的验证实验. 具体地说,我们在视频中进行了关于病鱼的互动分解。 图12的实验结果显示,我们的方法保持了出色的分解性能,尽管在0、25和51帧的背景中部分地包含了前方目标。

blocks.en: 4.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.2 限制

blocks.en: The designed FiVOS has certain limitations, primarily reflected in the following aspects:
blocks.zh: 设计出来的FiVOS有某些局限性,主要体现在以下几个方面:

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 13 , during the first round of interactions, target disappearance caused by occlusion occurs between frames 358 and 411, resulting in misrecognition at frame 415 (as shown in the left part).
Subsequent interaction on frame 411 removes the erroneous mask block in frame 415; however, the recognition of the correct target remains suboptimal (as shown in the right part).
This occurs because, in subsequent interaction propagation, the system increasingly relies on the fusion module, making it difficult for the user to flexibly remove unwanted mask blocks via the filter.
Owing to the characteristics of the fusion module, mask synthesis and correction in later interactions become more complex, limiting the filter’s precision and subsequently reducing system accuracy and user control.
blocks.zh:
如图13所示,在第一轮互动中,隔离导致的目标消失发生在第358至411帧之间,导致第415帧误认(如左部分所示)。
随后在帧411上的交互可以移除帧415中错误的遮罩块;然而,对正确目标的识别仍然不够理想(如右部分所示).
出现这种情况的原因是,在随后的互动传播中,系统越来越依赖聚变模块,使得用户难以通过过滤器灵活地去除不需要的面具块.
由于聚变模块的特性,后期相互作用中的遮罩合成和校正变得更加复杂,限制了滤波器的精度,随后降低了系统精度和用户控制.

blocks.zh: 图13:FIVOS限制的可视化:聚变模块在多轮相互作用中表现的次最佳.

blocks.en: Our system also exhibits significant limitations when handling small targets. As shown in Fig. 14 , we used juvenile goldfish as the validation experiment subject. In Fig. 14 (a), the target occupies only 0.8% of the image. Despite the algorithm’s general satisfactory performance after propagation, some masks still exhibit noticeable detail loss and instability in mask recognition. In Fig. 14 (b), the target size is further reduced to 0.2%, at which point the algorithm almost completely fails due to insufficient spatial resolution for effective feature extraction, leading to complete target loss.
blocks.zh: 在处理小目标时,我们的系统也表现出很大的局限性。 如图14所示,我们使用幼鱼金鱼作为鉴定实验对象。 在图14(a)中,目标仅占图像的0.8%。 尽管该算法在传播后总的性能令人满意,但有些口罩在口罩识别方面仍然显示出明显的细节损失和不稳定性. 在图14(b)中,目标大小进一步降低到0.2%,此时由于有效地物提取的空间分辨率不足,算法几乎完全失败,导致目标完全丢失.

blocks.en: 4.3 Application Prospects
blocks.zh: 4.3 应用前景

blocks.en:
We used the mask results generated by FiVOS to visualize fish movement trajectories. The specific steps are as follows: first, for each frame’s mask, we calculate its centroid position.
The centroid, representing the geometric center of all pixel points within the predicted target mask, effectively indicates the fish’s position in that frame.
By calculating the geometric moments of the mask image, we can quickly compute the centroid coordinates ( x t , y t ) (x_{t},y_{t}) , where x t x_{t} and y t y_{t} are the x and y coordinates of the mask in frame t.
Next, we collect and record the centroid coordinates for each frame. This step ensures a comprehensive understanding of the fish’s movement trajectory across the entire video sequence.
Finally, we connect the collected centroid coordinates in temporal sequence on the coordinate axis, forming a trajectory path map of the fish’s movement in the water, as shown in Figure 15 .
blocks.zh:
我们利用FiVOS生成的面具结果 来视觉鱼的运动轨迹。 具体的步骤如下: 第一,对于每个帧的面具,我们计算其中心机器人位置.
中间体代表了预测目标罩内所有像素点的几何中心,有效地表明了鱼在这个框架中的地位。
通过计算面具图像的几何瞬间,我们可以快速计算出中心机器人坐标(x t, y t) (x_{ t}, y_{ t}),其中x t x_{t}和y y_{t}是帧t中面具的x和y坐标.
接下来,我们收集并记录每个帧的中心行星坐标. 这一步骤确保全面了解鱼在整个视频序列中的移动轨迹。
最后,我们在坐标轴上按时间顺序连接收集的中间行星坐标,形成鱼在水中运动的轨迹路径图,如图15所示。

blocks.en:
This visualization approach allows for an intuitive display of fish swimming paths in water, providing data support for behavioral research and intelligent aquaculture management.
In the trajectory plot shown in Figure 15 , adjacent trajectory points are spaced 0.03 seconds apart. Increasing distance between points reflects an increase in swimming speed, potentially related to feeding or stress behaviors; decreasing point distances indicate slowing movement, where centroid distribution narrows or stagnates, possibly indicating poor health (such as hypoxia or death). This dynamic display reveals the fish’s movement state and behavioral characteristics.
Through trajectory data analysis, researchers can further identify normal activities such as foraging and resting, detect abnormal behaviors in a timely manner, and explore regional preferences, providing insights for optimizing feed distribution and water management.
Additionally, long-term tracking of trajectory changes can reveal fish responses to environmental factors (e.g., temperature, water quality). For instance, cold-water species like rainbow trout may cluster in cooler zones when temperature distribution is uneven, suggesting that environmental adjustments might be necessary.
Overall, trajectories derived from segmentation results reveal fish movement patterns and provide precise data support for intelligent aquaculture management.

这种可视化方法可以直观地显示水中的鱼游泳路径,为行为研究和智能水产养殖管理提供数据支持.
在图15所示的轨迹图中,相邻的轨迹点相距0.03秒. 点间距离的增大反映了游泳速度的增大,可能与喂食或应激行为有关;点间距离的缩小表明运动速度放缓,中间行星分布缩小或停滞,可能表明健康状况不佳(如缺氧或死亡). 这种动态显示揭示了鱼的运动状态和行为特征.
通过轨迹数据分析,研究人员可以进一步确定觅食和休息等正常活动,及时发现异常行为,探索区域偏好,为优化饲料分配和水管理提供见解.
此外,对轨迹变化的长期跟踪可以揭示鱼类对环境因素的反应(例如温度、水质)。 例如,在温度分布不均的情况下,虹鳟等冷水物种可能聚集在较冷的区域,这表明可能需要对环境进行调整。
总体而言,从分化结果中得出的轨迹揭示了鱼类运动模式,并为智能水产养殖管理提供了精确的数据支持.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
To address the difficulty of extracting specific target fish representation information in modern aquaculture due to high intra-class similarity, this paper proposes a novel interactive video object segmentation method, FiVOS.
We designed a simple and effective mask block filter. This filter employs a flexible hard-processing approach, precomputing the maximum centroid distance of mask blocks in an aquaculture dataset and setting it as the filter’s threshold. By calculating the distance between centroids of mask blocks in adjacent frames, it filters out erroneous masks early, resolving misidentification issues due to high intra-class similarity in aquaculture scenarios and addressing the accumulation of recognition errors in the STM model.
Additionally, we observed that after the mask block filter removes certain erroneous mask blocks, there may be a probability of error noise emerging. To address this, we introduced a noise filter after the mask block filter to further reduce the impact of minor noise on the recognition results.
Finally, comparative experiments with current state-of-the-art models were conducted on the fish aquaculture dataset and the DAVIS public dataset, along with ablation studies to further analyze the contributions of the model.
Experimental results demonstrate that our filter not only improves performance on the fish aquaculture dataset but also enhances long-term recognition accuracy and robustness. On the public dataset, its performance is also comparable to that of the original model.
blocks.zh:
为解决现代水产养殖中因阶级内部高度相似而难以提取特定目标鱼类代表信息的问题,本文提出了新型互动视频对象分化方法FiVOS.
我们设计了一个简单有效的面具屏蔽过滤器。 这个过滤器采用了灵活的硬处理方法,预先计算水产数据集中面具块的最大中间行星距离,并将其设定为过滤器的阈值。 它通过计算相邻框架内面具块的百分数之间的距离,及早过滤出错误的面具,解决因水产养殖场景中等级内高度相似而导致的错认问题,并解决STM模型中识别错误的积累.
此外,我们看到,在面具块过滤器移除某些错误的面具块后,可能会出现出错的噪音. 为了解决这个问题,我们在面具块滤波器之后引入了噪音滤波器,以进一步降低小噪音对识别结果的影响.
最后,对鱼类水产养殖数据集和DAVIS公共数据集进行了与目前最新模型的比较试验,并进行了消毒研究,以进一步分析模型的贡献。
实验结果表明,我们的过滤不仅提高了鱼类水产养殖数据集的性能,而且提高了长期识别准确性和稳健性。 在公共数据集上,其性能也与原始模型相当.

blocks.en:
Future work can focus on the following aspects: First, improving the design of the filter to enable better collaboration with the fusion module during subsequent interaction rounds, thereby enhancing the precision and user control in multi-round interactions.
Secondly, we will expand the diversity of our dataset by incorporating a broader range of fish species and color variations, aiming to enhance the algorithm’s effectiveness and user experience across a wider range of application scenarios. Finally, we plan to integrate multi-scale feature fusion and high-resolution input pipelines into our algorithm to enhance segmentation accuracy for small targets, accommodate objects of various sizes.
blocks.zh:
今后的工作可侧重于以下方面: 首先,改进滤波器的设计,以便在后续的相互作用回合中更好地与聚变模块合作,从而加强多回合相互作用中的精度和用户控制.
第二,我们将扩大数据集的多样性,纳入更广泛的鱼类种类和颜色变化,目的是在更广泛的应用情景中加强算法的有效性和用户经验。 最后,我们计划将多尺度的特性聚变和高分辨率输入管道整合到我们的算法中,以提高小目标的分化精度,容纳各种大小的物体.
